claim: ALNAV 011/26, DTG R 061945Z MAR 26, carries DON involuntary separation guidance
Scope: involuntary separation guidance under the policy on prioritizing military excellence and readiness
quote: establishes policy ... for involuntary separation of individuals who have a current diagnosis or history of, or exhibit symptoms consistent with, gender dysphoria
fix: The scope line omits who the ALNAV covers. State it governs involuntary separation of Service Members with a gender dysphoria diagnosis, history or symptoms.

claim: MARADMIN 189/26 implements the ALNAV for the Marine Corps and cites it as reference A
quote: REF A IS ALNAV 011/26 IMPLEMENTING POLICY ON PRIORITIZING MILITARY EXCELLENCE AND READINESS FOR INVOLUNTARY SEPARATION GUIDANCE
fix: MARADMIN 539/26 only removes paragraph 11 (extensions). It does not cancel MARADMIN 189/26. Supersession candidate rejected.

claim: Bonus, incentive and special pay terminate on placement in administrative absence until proceedings resolve, per MARADMIN 189/26 para 7.d.1
quote: will have that bonus, incentive, or special pay terminate upon placement in an administrative absence status until administrative separation proceedings are resolved
fix: ALNAV para 6.b says the pay remains unpaid in the same window. Paragraph 7.d.1 is untouched by MARADMIN 539/26.

claim: Retirement in lieu of involuntary separation for eligible Marines, per MARADMIN 189/26 para 8.a
quote: may request retirement in lieu of involuntary separation pursuant to reference (a)

claim: TERA exception requests for 15 to 18 years of service, per MARADMIN 189/26 para 8.a
quote: Marines with greater than 15 but less than 18 years of active service may request an exception to policy for TERA
